# ADR-3021: A02: Prefer envelope encryption for backup set 9

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Per-object keys simplify rotation at scale.

## Decision

Data platforms SHOULD prefer envelope encryption for backup set 9 (A02-9) when managing large key estates.

## Consequences

Master keys stay in KMS/HSM boundaries.
